references.citation: Wang et al., Multimodal mapping of cell types and projections in the central nucleus of the amygdala, eLife 12:e84262 (2023)
references.algorithm: L2 logistic regression and recursive feature elimination
references.scope: Central amygdala captured projection classes, not hypothalamic outputs
references.validation: Main stratified cell CV; selected markers additionally checked in a third animal

references.citation: Xu et al., High-throughput mapping of single-neuron projection and molecular features by retrograde barcoded labeling, eLife (2024)
references.scope: Prefrontal source, including LH as a destination
references.validation: Random cell split, not established animal-held-out evaluation

references.citation: Zheng et al., SPIDER-Seq, National Science Review (2026)
references.scope: Prefrontal inputs to LHA; not hypothalamic-source geometry
references.validation: Cell splitting; separate MERFISH spatial comparisons are not same-cell projection truth

references.citation: Sun et al., Integrating barcoded neuroanatomy with spatial transcriptional profiling enables identification of gene correlates of projections, Nature Neuroscience (2021)
references.algorithm: NMF projection modules, Gaussian-process spatial regression and gene regression
references.validation: Neuron-level cross-validation; animal-fold grouping not established
references.role: Strong nonlinear anatomy controls and fitting-only output representations

references.citation: Sorensen et al., Connecting single-cell transcriptomes to projectomes in the mouse visual cortex, Nature (2026)
references.algorithm: Sparse reduced-rank representation and ridge logistic projection models
references.validation: Checked projection code withholds cells, not animals
references.restriction: Do not turn population alignment into assumed individual RNA/full-axon pairs

references.citation: Elkan and Noto, Learning classifiers from only positive and unlabeled data, KDD (2008)
references.scope: General learning framework, not neuronal validation
references.required_assumption: Labelled positives selected completely at random among positives
references.role: Conditional reference for detection and missingness; not a default tracing correction

adoption_order: Resolve exact animal groups and target-assay masks
Freeze one regularized logistic candidate and strong controls
Require nonlinear anatomy, frequency, technical and nearest-neighbour comparisons
Keep feature selection and calibration within fitting groups
Assess proper probability scores and calibration on independent groups
Consider representation or geometry extensions only after a reliable destination gain
guardrails: Captured label probability is not automatically anatomical projection probability
Nondetection and unassayed targets are not verified negatives
Gene and geometry pairing must be genuinely measured or validated
No literature score is a Synarch result
No author source code, weights or datasets are republished by this catalogue
No new fitting, old test reopening, viewer promotion or author contact
